name: Question 2
problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+2y=3 \\ -4y+5z=6 \\ 7x+8z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+2y+0z=3 \\ 0x-4y+5z=6 \\ 7x+0y+8z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & \,\,\,-4 & 5 \\ 7 & 0 & 8\end{aligned}]
$$

What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

{x+2y=3−4y+5z=67x+8z=9

a
[12−3−45−678−9]
b
[1200−45708]

[123−456789]

[1072−40058]
e
[12030−4567089]
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered x,y,z on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

{x+2y+0z=30x−4y+5z=67x+0y+8z=9

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

[1200−45708]
